scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street at night with a large tree on the left side and a yellow truck on the right side. The street is lined with buildings and has many pedestrians walking along it. There are also several streetlights illuminating the area. The sky is dark with a few clouds.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are tall and modern with a mix of glass and concrete facades. Some have balconies and others have large windows.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt and has a smooth finish. There are also some decorative elements such as planters and sculptures.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and tables scattered throughout the area, providing places for people to sit and rest.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees lining the street, providing shade and adding to the aesthetic appeal of the area.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs advertising businesses and services, including a restaurant and a coffee shop.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: People are walking in all directions, some alone and others in groups.
scene_analysis.lighting_atmosphere: The lighting is dim, with only a few streetlights illuminating the area.
scene_analysis.as_resident: Some locals seem to enjoy spending time outdoors, while others prefer to stay indoors.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The area is a convenient location for those who need to commute to work or school.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The area offers a range of activities and attractions for visitors.
scene_analysis.as_student: Many students and young professionals are working in the area, taking advantage of the nearby universities.
